name: inset-step
why: A 100 x 60 rectangle whose right edge steps in by 3 at y = 40, inset by 10 - deeper than the step - and extruded 5. The 3 mm step edge has no offset of its own at 10 mm (the bisectors from its two ends meet 3 mm in), yet intersection joins keep the step in the inset: (10,10) (90,10) (90,30) (87,30) (87,50) (10,50), 80*40 - 3*20 = 3140 mm2, 15700 mm3 exactly, eight planar faces. The corner at (87,30) is 10*sqrt(2) from the outline's re-entrant corner at (97,40).
